info.title: DESCRIPTION
info.body: Powertrack™ is a high performance road marking paint designed for use on road surfaces. It is applied in molten state by mechanical means together with specified glass beads to provide good retro-reflectance on road pavements.

info.title: FEATURES
info.body:
Ensures good adhesion on road surfaces and glass bead retention to maintain the required retro-reflectance values
Fast drying
Improved crack resistance

info.title: PRINCIPAL USES
info.body: For use of a reflective thermoplastic stripping material on concrete and asphalt road pavements

info.title: SURFACE PREPARATION
info.body: Surface should be clean and dry, free from oil, grease, dirt, contaminants, and all loose grit and mortar.

info.title: MATERIAL PREPARATION
info.body: Powertrack™ Thermoplastic Road Marking Paint is preheated to 180-220°C, allowing 15 to 20 minutes before application. Maintain required temperatures while constantly stirring. Mixture should be applied within 4 hours.

info.title: APPLICATION SCHEDULE
info.body:
1. Apply suitable primer as required or specified.
2. Using the appropriate hand propelled machine, self-propelled machine, or by hand screed, apply coating at 1.8 to 2.2 mm thickness. Apply succeeding coats to conform to specified coat thickness after the subsequent coat has completely dried.
3. Scatter specified glass beads at recommended loading of 300-400 g/m<sup>2</sup> when the finish coat is at touch-dry stage.
4. Allow finished surfaces to completely dry hard before opening to foot and vehicular traffic.
